subject: Trial runway + closing incentive for BridgeStone AI — voucher ask
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@bridgestone.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Trial runway + closing incentive for BridgeStone AI — voucher ask

Hi Elaine,

Great call this morning — thanks for walking through the pilot results and the success metrics the team hit. BridgeStone's evaluation is shaping up nicely and I think we're in a strong spot to convert, but the procurement team wants a bit more runway and a closing incentive to align the internal stakeholders.

As discussed, would Redwood be able to provide:
- 30-day trial extension on the current environment
- $3,000 in platform credit (voucher codes) that can be applied to usage in month one post-conversion

I attached the updated pricing sheet and a simple mutual action plan to show how the extension + credit maps to the first 60 days of usage (pricing-sheet-q3.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

If you can confirm procurement requirements (PO terms, invoicing cadence), I can route this through my managers for quick approval. Proposed next step: I’ll request signoff from Ben + Revenue Ops and get voucher codes issued by EOD Wednesday if procurement is OK.

Best,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]
[Attachment: pricing-sheet-q3.pdf]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx]

From: Elaine Park <elaine@bridgestone.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@bridgestone.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway + closing incentive for BridgeStone AI — voucher ask

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks — that sounds reasonable and aligns with what our business stakeholders want to see. A couple of quick questions from procurement:
1) Are these credits transferable between our teams/projects?
2) Can Redwood confirm that credits do not affect data residency or billing terms?
3) We will need an updated SOW or amendment reflecting the trial extension and voucher usage policy.

If you can loop in your finance/ops (and the person who can issue the voucher manifest) we can move fast. Procurement prefers a simple amendment + PO to keep internal audit happy.

—Elaine
Elaine Park | Head of Platform, BridgeStone AI
[elaine@bridgestone.ai]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial runway + closing incentive for BridgeStone AI — voucher ask

Ben — forwarding Elaine's note. BridgeStone is asking for a 30-day extension + $3k in credits (voucher codes). Procurement wants an amendment + confirmation on credit transferability and billing terms.

Quick ask: can we approve the $3k voucher from the conversion pool and have RevOps generate the voucher-manifest.csv? If yes, I’ll share the amendment template and ask BridgeStone to issue a PO.

Why this matters: BridgeStone is mid-stage with potential to go Dedicated next quarter; converting now avoids competitor entrenchment.

Thanks,
Jasmine

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial runway + closing incentive for BridgeStone AI — voucher ask

Jasmine — approved.

Approve $3,000 voucher from the Q3 conversion incentive pool. Conditions:
- Voucher valid for 60 days from issuance and applied to first billing cycle post-conversion
- Non-transferable beyond BridgeStone legal entity unless procurement explicitly requests and signs amendment
- Voucher issuance requires RevOps ticket and voucher-manifest.csv for audit trail

Marissa — can you confirm RevOps can generate the manifest and coordinate issuance? Vivek, loop in Finance if we need any GL code mapping for the PO.

Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Sales — West
[Attachment: approval-note.txt]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial runway + closing incentive for BridgeStone AI — voucher ask

>

RevOps confirmed — we can generate the manifest and issue the voucher codes once we have:
- Signed amendment or PO referencing RDW-2027-0893
- Billing contact + remit instructions

I’ve created the RevOps ticket: RO-4729 and attached a CSV stub for the voucher manifest. I’ll publish the codes to a secure link and share it with Jasmine and Procurement once the PO is attached to the ticket.

[Attachment: voucher-manifest.csv]

Marissa Cole | Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@bridgestone.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@bridgestone.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway + closing incentive for BridgeStone AI — voucher ask

Hi Elaine — great news. Ben and RevOps are aligned to issue a $3,000 voucher and a 30-day trial extension once BridgeStone attaches a PO or countersigns the simple amendment. Procurement asked for the amendment to capture transferability and billing terms — I attached a one-page amendment template for quick review.

Next steps:
- Please confirm PO number or sign the amendment and send back to me (procurement@bridgestone.ai can reply-all)
- Once we have PO/AMENDMENT, RevOps (RO-4729) will issue voucher codes and I’ll email the manifest to the billing contact.

Voucher details (provisional):
- Amount: $3,000 USD
- Validity: 60 days from issuance
- Usage: applied to first post-conversion invoice

If procurement prefers, I can create a short call with Ben + Marissa to walk them through the amendment and issuance process tomorrow AM.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]
[Attachment: amendment-template.pdf]
